name: psychology
description: Psychology is a non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection connector for published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments. It uses the hosted MCP endpoint at https://noesis.seges.ai/mcp. A host is supported only after that exact host and version completes a recorded OAuth authorization-code and S256 PKCE acceptance test. Psychology does not provide therapy, diagnosis, or treatment.

interface.shortDescription: Non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection through a hosted MCP connector.
interface.longDescription: Psychology supports structured self-reflection with published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments and plain-language interpretation. It is not therapy, diagnosis, or treatment. The public connector uses an OAuth authorization-code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE; do not paste a static token or credential. A host is supported only after its exact version has a recorded acceptance result. Signed-in storage reads require the applicable consent and an explicit per-session source choice; stored results, profiles, and journal content are never loaded by default. Referral results are informational leads only, and users independently verify credentials, availability, scope, and suitability.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a non-clinical self-reflection exercise.
Explain the limits of this assessment in plain language.
Before using saved context, show me the available sources and let me choose.
